description: Imports into Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman, Qatar, Kuwait and Bahrain from 2015 of PV cells and modules, lithium-ion cells, wind turbines, static converters, electrolysis machines and large transformers, by product group, year and the five largest partners (partner `WLD` is the total). US dollars as declared (CIF). Derived aggregates only: UN Comtrade does not allow its rows to be republished. HS 850440 and 854330 are broad codes and HS 854140 (before 2022) includes LEDs; the note says so.
name: equipment_trade
title: Clean-energy equipment imports into the GCC (UN Comtrade, derived)
